component.name: SQLCraft
component.summary: Manage SQL Server databases and run T-SQL queries

description.p: A SQL Server management tool for Linux in the style of SQL Server Management Studio.

ul.li: Object Explorer for databases, tables, views, procedures, functions, logins and Agent jobs
Query windows with T-SQL highlighting, GO batches, and running just the selected text
Results grid, Messages tab with PRINT output and row counts, and CSV export
Script objects as CREATE, ALTER, SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, DROP or EXECUTE
SQL Server and Windows (NTLM) logins, with passwords kept in the system keyring
